verdict.rationale: Windmill documents headless operation in several ways. The `wmill` CLI works with instances from the terminal, deployments can run via the CLI from a Git repository, and git sync auto-deploys new commits. A published OpenAPI spec, scoped API tokens and webhook/HTTP triggers also support programmatic, unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI examples, pre-merge validation runs), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Windmill CLI, `wmill` allows you to interact with Windmill instances right from your terminal.
as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
Windmill can automatically deploy new commits from the repository into the workspace
Tokens can be scoped to restrict access to specific resources and actions, following the principle of least privilege.
Windmill's cloud instance serves its OpenAPI 3.0.3 document live at /api/openapi.json
